body:
did you know: taylor and ed sheeran wrote "everything has changed" sitting on a trampoline in her backyard.

she'd found him as an up-and-comer and brought him out on the road; when it came time to actually write together, the setting was a backyard trampoline. she pulled in butch walker to produce because she wanted it to come "from an organic place, which is where [ed] comes from."

the video cast two kids as elementary-school classmates falling into an easy friendship -- then revealed taylor and ed at the end as their parents. and nine years later, the same two child actors were brought back, grown up, for ed's 2022 "the joker and the queen" video (with taylor) -- which fans read as a deliberate sequel to that little story.

some friendships you write on a trampoline and then check back in on a decade later.
